# Pidgeon

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083), [v1 c15 P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher at Brierley School  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>

## Appearance

Mr. Pidgeon is a schoolmaster who twirls his mustache while teaching.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)_

## Personality

Mr. Pidgeon is considered an overbearing, ineffective, and lenient teacher who struggles to maintain proper discipline in his classroom. He ignores younger students to focus on older pupils preparing for Regent's, and he shows blatant romantic favoritism toward Sukey Pullen.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083), [v1 c15 P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)_

## Traits

- Overbearing  <sub>[v1 c15 P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083)</sub>
- Ineffective instructor  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>
- Lenient and poor disciplinarian  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>
- Showed favoritism  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>

## Abilities

- Teaching fundamental subjects like Latin, geometry, French, and algebra  <sub>[v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037)</sub>
- Poetry composition  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>
- Dramatic recitations  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>

## Goals

- Prepare older students for the Regent's class  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>

## History

Mr. Pidgeon served as the schoolmaster at Brierley School, where he instructed pupils in advanced subjects such as Latin, algebra, French, and geometry. During his time at the school, his teaching abilities and classroom management were heavily criticized by community members like Mrs. Sowerby. On one occasion, he caused significant distress to Nell Harcourt by overbearingly reprimanding her and forcing her to sit alongside Hugh Carrow as a punishment for tardiness, prompting Nell to temporarily refuse to return to school. When the academic term concluded, he advanced Nell and Hugh Carrow to the fifth class. He eventually left his position at Brierley School after delivering a parting address to his students.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083), [v1 c15 P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037), [v1 c17 P38](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0038)_
